passages.text: Then Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people: “Keep all the commandments I am giving you today.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
The elders of Israel were also leaders.
Moses and the elders spoke to the people of Israel.
They gave a command to the people.
They said, "Keep all the commandments."
These are the commandments I am giving you today.
passages.original: וַיְצַ֤ו מֹשֶׁה֙ וְזִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר שָׁמֹר֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַמִּצְוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃

passages.text: And on the day you cross the Jordan into the land that the LORD your God is giving you, set up large stones and coat them with plaster.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He is giving you a land.
You will cross the Jordan River.
On that day, enter the land God gives you.
Set up large stones for yourself.
Cover these stones with plaster.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֗ה בַּיּוֹם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעַבְר֣וּ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּן֒ אֶל־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֣ן לָ֑ךְ וַהֲקֵמֹתָ֤ לְךָ֙ אֲבָנִ֣ים גְּדֹל֔וֹת וְשַׂדְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם בַּשִּֽׂיד׃

passages.text: Write on them all the words of this law when you have crossed over to enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised you.
passages.sermon:
Moses led the people of Israel.
God chose Moses to give His law to the people.
God promised to give the people a special land.
This land flows with milk and honey.
God made this promise to the fathers of Israel.
God keeps His promises.
When you cross the Jordan River, you will enter this land.
God, your God, gives you this land.
Set up large stones.
Coat the stones with plaster.
Write all the words of this law on the stones.
Do this after you cross over.
Write so that you may enter the land God gives you.
God, the God of your fathers, promised this land to you.
passages.original: וְכָתַבְתָּ֣ עֲלֵיהֶ֗ן אֶֽת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֛י הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את בְּעָבְרֶ֑ךָ לְמַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ תָּבֹ֨א אֶל־ הָאָ֜רֶץ אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֣יךָ׀ נֹתֵ֣ן לְךָ֗ אֶ֣רֶץ זָבַ֤ת חָלָב֙ וּדְבַ֔שׁ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ אֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: And when you have crossed the Jordan, you are to set up these stones on Mount Ebal, as I am commanding you today, and you are to coat them with plaster.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He is giving you the land across the Jordan.
You will cross the Jordan River.
After you cross, go to Mount Ebal.
Set up the stones I command you today.
Coat these stones with plaster.
passages.original: וְהָיָה֮ בְּעָבְרְכֶ֣ם אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּן֒ תָּקִ֜ימוּ אֶת־ הָאֲבָנִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֜י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֛ם הַיּ֖וֹם בְּהַ֣ר עֵיבָ֑ל וְשַׂדְתָּ֥ אוֹתָ֖ם בַּשִּֽׂיד׃

passages.text: Moreover, you are to build there an altar to the LORD your God, an altar of stones. You must not use any iron tool on them.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God commands you to build an altar.
You must build this altar at that place.
You must build the altar for the LORD your God.
You must use stones to build the altar.
You must not use any iron tool on the stones.
passages.original: וּבָנִ֤יתָ שָּׁם֙ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ מִזְבַּ֣ח אֲבָנִ֔ים לֹא־ תָנִ֥יף עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם בַּרְזֶֽל׃

passages.text: You shall build the altar of the LORD your God with uncut stones and offer upon it burnt offerings to the LORD your God.
passages.sermon:
You must build an altar.
This altar is for the LORD your God.
You must use uncut stones to build the altar.
You must not shape the stones with any tool.
You must offer burnt offerings on this altar.
You must give these offerings to the LORD your God.
passages.original: אֲבָנִ֤ים שְׁלֵמוֹת֙ תִּבְנֶ֔ה אֶת־ מִזְבַּ֖ח יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְהַעֲלִ֤יתָ עָלָיו֙ עוֹלֹ֔ת לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: There you are to sacrifice your peace offerings, eating them and rejoicing in the presence of the LORD your God.
passages.sermon:
You must bring your peace offerings to the altar of the LORD your God.
You must sacrifice your peace offerings there.
You must eat the offerings there.
You must rejoice there.
You must rejoice in the presence of the LORD your God.
passages.original: וְזָבַחְתָּ֥ שְׁלָמִ֖ים וְאָכַ֣לְתָּ שָּׁ֑ם וְשָׂ֣מַחְתָּ֔ לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: And you shall write distinctly upon these stones all the words of this law.”
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel His law.
\r\nGod commanded Israel to build an altar with uncut stones.
\r\nGod told Israel to write on these stones.
\r\nYou must write all the words of this law on the stones.
\r\nYou must write the words clearly.
\r\nEveryone must be able to read and understand the law on the stones.
passages.original: וְכָתַבְתָּ֣ עַל־ הָאֲבָנִ֗ים אֶֽת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֛י הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את בַּאֵ֥ר הֵיטֵֽב׃ס

passages.text: Then Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel: “Be silent, O Israel, and listen! This day you have become the people of the LORD your God.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
The Levitical priests served God.
Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel.
They said, “Be silent, Israel.
Listen carefully.
Today you have become the people of the LORD your God.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים הַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֶ֥ל כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר הַסְכֵּ֤ת׀ וּשְׁמַע֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַיּ֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ נִהְיֵ֣יתָֽ לְעָ֔ם לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: You shall therefore obey the voice of the LORD your God and follow His commandments and statutes I am giving you today.”
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God is your God.
You must listen to God's voice.
You must obey God.
You must do God's commandments.
You must keep God's statutes.
I am giving you these commandments and statutes today.
passages.original: וְשָׁ֣מַעְתָּ֔ בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ אֶת־ מִצְוֺתָו֙ וְאֶת־ חֻקָּ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּֽוֹם׃ס

passages.text: On that day Moses commanded the people: “When you have crossed the Jordan, these tribes shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
On that day, Moses gave a command to the people of Israel.
He spoke to all the people.
He said, “You will cross the Jordan River.
After you cross the Jordan, some tribes must stand on Mount Gerizim.
These tribes will bless the people.
The tribes are Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.”
passages.original: וַיְצַ֤ו מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא לֵאמֹֽר׃ אֵ֠לֶּה יַֽעַמְד֞וּ לְבָרֵ֤ךְ אֶת־ הָעָם֙ עַל־ הַ֣ר גְּרִזִ֔ים בְּעָבְרְכֶ֖ם אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן שִׁמְעוֹן֙ וְלֵוִ֣י וִֽיהוּדָ֔ה וְיִשָּׂשכָ֖ר וְיוֹסֵ֥ף וּבִנְיָמִֽן׃

passages.text: And these tribes shall stand on Mount Ebal to deliver the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the people of Israel on that day.
He gave them a command.
Six tribes must stand on Mount Ebal.
These tribes are Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
They will stand there to deliver the curse.
passages.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה יַֽעַמְד֥וּ עַל־ הַקְּלָלָ֖ה בְּהַ֣ר עֵיבָ֑ל רְאוּבֵן֙ גָּ֣ד וְאָשֵׁ֔ר וּזְבוּלֻ֖ן דָּ֥ן וְנַפְתָּלִֽי׃

passages.text: Then the Levites shall proclaim in a loud voice to every Israelite: ‘Cursed is the man who makes a carved idol or molten image—an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of a craftsman—and sets it up in secret.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
passages.sermon:
Moses led the people of Israel.
He gave them commands from God.
The Levites were priests from the tribe of Levi.
The Levites spoke to all the Israelites.
They spoke in a loud voice.
They said, “Cursed is the man who makes a carved idol.
Cursed is the man who makes a molten image.
These idols are an abomination to the LORD.
A craftsman makes these idols with his hands.
The man sets up the idol in secret.
All the people must answer.
All the people must say, ‘Amen.’”
passages.original: וְעָנ֣וּ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם וְאָֽמְר֛וּ אֶל־ כָּל־ אִ֥ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל ק֥וֹל רָֽם׃ס אָר֣וּר הָאִ֡ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַעֲשֶׂה֩ פֶ֨סֶל וּמַסֵּכָ֜ה תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה מַעֲשֵׂ֛ה יְדֵ֥י חָרָ֖שׁ וְשָׂ֣ם בַּסָּ֑תֶר וְעָנ֧וּ כָל־ הָעָ֛ם וְאָמְר֖וּ אָמֵֽן׃ס

passages.text: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or mother.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
passages.sermon:
God gave commands to Israel.
God spoke through the Levites.
The Levites spoke to all the people.
They spoke with a loud voice.
They said, “Cursed is the person who dishonors his father or his mother.”
All the people must answer, “Amen.”
passages.original: אָר֕וּר מַקְלֶ֥ה אָבִ֖יו וְאִמּ֑וֹ וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס

passages.text: ‘Cursed is he who moves his neighbor’s boundary stone.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
passages.sermon:
The Levites speak to all Israel in a loud voice.
They say, “Cursed is the person who moves his neighbor’s boundary stone.”
This person tries to take land that does not belong to him.
He acts dishonestly against his neighbor.
All the people must answer, “Amen.”
passages.original: אָר֕וּר מַסִּ֖יג גְּב֣וּל רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס

passages.text: ‘Cursed is he who lets a blind man wander in the road.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
passages.sermon:
God gives a warning to the people.
He speaks about those who harm the vulnerable.
A blind man cannot see the road.
If someone lets a blind man wander in the road, that person does wrong.
God says this person is cursed.
All the people must agree.
They must say, “Amen.”
passages.original: אָר֕וּר מַשְׁגֶּ֥ה עִוֵּ֖ר בַּדָּ֑רֶךְ וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס

passages.text: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
passages.sermon:
God gives a warning to the people.
He speaks about justice.
He says, “Cursed is the person who withholds justice.”
This means someone does not give fair treatment.
God names three groups who need justice.
The first group is the foreigner.
The second group is the fatherless.
The third group is the widow.
God says it is wrong to treat these people unfairly.
He says a curse will come on anyone who does this.
All the people must agree with God’s warning.
They must say, “Amen.”
passages.original: אָר֗וּר מַטֶּ֛ה מִשְׁפַּ֥ט גֵּר־ יָת֖וֹם וְאַלְמָנָ֑ה וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס

passages.text: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his father’s wife, for he has violated his father’s marriage bed.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
passages.sermon:
God gives a warning to the people.
He says, “Cursed is the man who sleeps with his father’s wife.”
This man has violated his father’s marriage bed.
All the people must say, “Amen.”
passages.original: אָר֗וּר שֹׁכֵב֙ עִם־ אֵ֣שֶׁת אָבִ֔יו כִּ֥י גִלָּ֖ה כְּנַ֣ף אָבִ֑יו וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס

passages.text: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any animal.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
passages.sermon: God curses anyone who lies with any animal.\r\nAll the people must say, "Amen."
passages.original: אָר֕וּר שֹׁכֵ֖ב עִם־ כָּל־ בְּהֵמָ֑ה וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס

passages.text: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
passages.sermon:
God gives a command to His people.
He warns against sexual sin.
A man must not sleep with his sister.
His sister may be the daughter of his father.
Or she may be the daughter of his mother.
If a man does this, he is cursed.
All the people must agree.
All the people must say, “Amen.”
passages.original: אָר֗וּר שֹׁכֵב֙ עִם־ אֲחֹת֔וֹ בַּת־ אָבִ֖יו א֣וֹ בַת־ אִמּ֑וֹ וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס

passages.text: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his mother-in-law.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
passages.sermon: A man who sleeps with his mother-in-law is cursed.\r\nAll the people must say, "Amen."
passages.original: אָר֕וּר שֹׁכֵ֖ב עִם־ חֹֽתַנְתּ֑וֹ וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס

passages.text: ‘Cursed is he who strikes down his neighbor in secret.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
passages.sermon:
God gave laws to Israel.
God warned the people.
He said, “Cursed is the person who strikes his neighbor in secret.”
The people must answer, “Amen.”
passages.original: אָר֕וּר מַכֵּ֥ה רֵעֵ֖הוּ בַּסָּ֑תֶר וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס

passages.text: ‘Cursed is he who accepts a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
passages.sermon:
God gave laws to His people.
God warned them about evil actions.
A person who takes money to kill an innocent person is cursed.
This person accepts a bribe.
This person causes the death of someone who did nothing wrong.
All the people must agree.
All the people must say, “Amen.”
passages.original: אָרוּר֙ לֹקֵ֣חַ שֹׁ֔חַד לְהַכּ֥וֹת נֶ֖פֶשׁ דָּ֣ם נָקִ֑י וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס

passages.text: ‘Cursed is he who does not put the words of this law into practice.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
passages.sermon:
God gave His law to the people of Israel.
God commanded the people to obey His law.
Anyone who does not obey the words of this law is cursed.
All the people must say, "Amen."
passages.original: אָר֗וּר אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא־ יָקִ֛ים אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֥י הַתּוֹרָֽה־ הַזֹּ֖את לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת אוֹתָ֑ם וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃פ
